newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ayala unit to buy property in Singapore.
newsitem.headline: Ayala unit to buy property in Singapore.

text.p: Ayala International Properties Pte Ltd said on Wednesday it had joined a consortium to buy the Forum, a retail and office building complex along Orchard Road in Singapore for S$359 million.

A statement by parent Ayala Land Inc said the firm had joined a subsidiary of Grosvenor Estate Holdings of the United Kingdom and two Singapore companies - Hotel Properties Ltd and SC Global Pte Ltd - to buy the property.
The existing owner of the building is Forum Development Pte Ltd.
The property will be bought through a firm called Hermil Investments Pte Ltd in which Ayala has a 23 percent stake.
"The acquisition is in keeping with the Ayala Group's strategy of exploring business opportunities overseas, particularly in the Asia Pacific region," the statement said.
